title: Local CSS overrides
description:
Layout-quality metric — how many objects carry local CSS instead of taking their appearance from the theme. Local overrides are normal in small numbers; a high share means the theme has stopped governing the look and every visual change has to be made object by object. This is a ratio dashboard: the KPIs give the solution-wide share and the table lists layouts above the threshold, not individual objects.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "LocalCSS" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Local CSS wins over the theme. Once a large share of objects carries its own styling, the theme no longer describes what users see and a rebranding turns into manual work on every object.
rule.remediation: Move recurring local styling into theme styles and reapply them, so the theme governs the appearance again.
